name: Mumain
text: Mumain is a variant form of the goddess name Mugain. The dictionary adds a second pointer to Mór Muman, the Munster goddess who now and then takes Mumain as her name alone.

attributes.attribute: variant form of the name Mugain
name carried alone at times by the goddess Mór Muman
